description: Masking, writes and schema changes: a masked write target is never wrapped, so its masked columns may appear only as bare RETURNING outputs, masked in place. Masked tables read inside a write are wrapped like any read, and a held write's preview counts over the same masked sources. Renaming or moving a masked or labeled table, and schema changes that reference or evaluate masked data, deny.
